data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images with rotation and limited legibility. Opening gross claims outstanding (313.8) was read from the balance sheet liabilities column for 2016 but the scan quality makes the last digits moderately uncertain (confidence 0.8). A clear GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be located or unambiguously read in the provided images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Segmental premium class names and line amounts were transcribed from a partially legible segmental analysis table and consolidated 'Reinsurance acceptances' was estimated so that totals match the reported gross premium figure; these names/amounts should be treated as approximate (confidence 0.6). No clear gross claims development triangle or explicit named event reserve movements were confidently extracted from the images.
